transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… thank you, doctor. I’m here because I’ve been having a really hard time with flying. I know it probably sounds irrational, and I’m a bit embarrassed to say it, but even just thinking about getting on an airplane scares me so much. In my head I know it doesn’t really make sense, but my body reacts like the plane is definitely going to fall.
Is your fear limited to flying, or do you experience similar anxiety in other situations, such as in crowds, during public speaking, or in enclosed spaces?

It’s really mainly flying, doctor. I mean… I don’t like feeling trapped anywhere, I guess, but nothing gets me like the airplane thing. Just the thought of getting on one scares me so badly, and I know that doesn’t make sense, but my body reacts like the plane is going to fall.
